description: This file contains the implementation of the JsonCodec class and related classes for JSON serialization in the Orleans framework. It includes codec configuration options, extension methods for serializer registration, and the JsonCodec class itself that implements various serialization, copying, and filtering interfaces.

classes.name: JsonCodec
classes.description: A serializer codec implementing JSON serialization and deserialization, copying, and filtering interfaces within Orleans.

classes.name: JsonCodecOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for JSON serialization behavior, including support for predicate functions determining copyable and serializable types, and specific JSON serialization settings.

classes.name: SerializationHostingExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods for adding JSON serializer support to Orleans serializer builder.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of an object, implementation not shown.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported for copying.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value from a buffer during deserialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a field to a buffer during serialization.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a type is allowed based on filtering rules.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a type can be serialized.

methods.name: AddJsonSerializer
methods.description: Extension method to add JSON serializer with support predicates.

methods.name: AddJsonSerializer
methods.description: Extension method to add JSON serializer with preset options.
